webhooks.detail: Webhooks for incoming messages, delivery status updates, errors; subscribe per WABA via app webhook config

evidence.quote: Webhooks deliver JSON payloads to your server for message status updates, incoming messages, asynchronous error handling, and many other notification utilities.

sandbox.detail: Test WhatsApp account, test business phone number auto-created with Cloud API get-started; no payment method needed for template messages; relaxed limits. Also a calling sandbox account.

evidence.quote: Test accounts and test phone numbers are useful for testing purposes, as they have relaxed messaging limits and don't require a payment method on file in order to send template messages.

rate_limits.summary: 200 req/hr per app per Messaging account default (5000/hr for active accounts with a registered number); messaging throughput 80 msg/s per phone number by default (up to 1000)
